text: Transition metal (TM) catalyzed cross-coupling reactions are the utmost versatile and reliable methods for the production of many industrially important fine chemicals. text: This review article focuses on the recent advances in developing nanostructured catalysts and their utilization for selective carbon–carbon bond-forming reactions, e.g., Suzuki, Heck, and Sonogashira coupling reactions.
